clause: The Receiving Party agrees to hold in confidence and not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party for a period of ten (10) years from the date of disclosure.
policy: Confidentiality obligations must survive for a maximum period of three (3) years from the date of disclosure.
rewritten_clause: The Receiving Party agrees to hold in confidence and not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party for a period of three (3) years from the date of disclosure.
explanation: The original clause specified a 10-year term for confidentiality, which violates the company policy restricting confidentiality terms to a maximum of 3 years. The term was modified to align with the policy.

clause: Payment for all invoices shall be made within 90 days of receipt.
policy: Standard payment terms are Net 30 days from the date of invoice receipt.
rewritten_clause: Payment for all invoices shall be made within 30 days of receipt.
explanation: The payment term of 90 days was reduced to 30 days to comply with the standard Net 30 payment policy.

clause: Under no circumstances shall the Service Provider's total liability exceed the total amount paid under this Agreement in the six months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
policy: Liability caps must be set to no less than the total amount paid under the Agreement over the preceding twelve (12) months.
rewritten_clause: Under no circumstances shall the Service Provider's total liability exceed the total amount paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
explanation: The liability cap was increased from a six-month trailing revenue to a twelve-month trailing revenue to meet the minimum liability cap policy.

clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon written notice.
policy: Termination for convenience requires at least thirty (30) days prior written notice.
rewritten_clause: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon thirty (30) days prior written notice.
explanation: The termination clause lacked a notice period. Added a 30-day prior written notice requirement for convenience termination in accordance with company policy.

clause: The Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless the Vendor from any and all claims, including those arising from the Vendor's own negligence.
policy: The company shall not indemnify the vendor for claims arising from the vendor's own negligence or willful misconduct.
rewritten_clause: The Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless the Vendor from any and all claims, excluding those arising from the Vendor's own negligence or willful misconduct.
explanation: The indemnification clause improperly included indemnification for the vendor's own negligence. Added an exclusion for the vendor's negligence and willful misconduct to comply with risk management policies.

clause: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless written notice of non-renewal is provided at least 5 days prior to the expiration date.
policy: Auto-renewal clauses must require at least 60 days advance notice to opt out.
rewritten_clause: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless written notice of non-renewal is provided at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration date.
explanation: The opt-out notice period for auto-renewal was increased from 5 days to 60 days as per the auto-renewal policy.
